task_source_checker.name: bgmv-pure-source-check
command:
from pathlib import Path
import ast,json,importlib.util
root=Path.cwd();base=root/'bench/repairs/tritonbench_g/bgmv_shrink_kernel_physical';path=base/'check_candidate.py'
selected=[node for node in ast.parse(path.read_text()).body if isinstance(node,ast.FunctionDef) and node.name in ['function','check_source']]
env={'HERE':base,'ROOT':root,'SOURCE':base/'bgmv_shrink_kernel_repaired.py','ORIGINAL':base.parent/'bgmv_shrink_kernel/bgmv_shrink_kernel_repaired.py','ast':ast,'json':json,'importlib':__import__('importlib')}
exec(compile(ast.Module(selected,type_ignores=[]),str(path),'exec'),env)
print(json.dumps(env['check_source'](),sort_keys=True))
